items.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Edit the attached 2048x2048 equal 4 by 4 template. Paint EXACTLY sixteen independent vocabulary illustrations in row-major order. Preserve ALL FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical continuous straight pure MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines INCLUDING OUTER FRAME, exact positions, thickness, equal cell sizes and canvas dimensions. Magenta ONLY in grid lines. Paint only white cell interiors. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with crisp recognizable structure. Use cells generously; no large blank margins required. Every complete subject, background and shadow stays inside its own cell. No text, letters, numerals, labels, logos or watermarks. No copyrighted characters, franchise creatures, recognizable silhouettes, signature character color schemes, game interfaces, official icons or imitation of franchise artwork. Generic original ordinary people only. For a fictional move, show only an original abstract natural effect, ordinary non-character object or generic unbranded training dummy, never any Pokemon or other franchise character. For sports moves show accurately differentiated adult athletes in plain sportswear in a sports setting, anatomically correct arms, hands and legs. For proverbs show an understandable scene expressing the meaning, not merely random objects from the title. Sixteen scenes in exact order:

1. １０まんボルト: 強い電気で攻撃する技。

2. かえんほうしゃ: 炎を吹き出して攻撃する技。

3. れいとうビーム: 冷たい光線で攻撃する技。

4. れいとうパンチ: 冷たい力をこめた拳で攻撃する技。

5. ほのおのパンチ: 炎をこめた拳で攻撃する技。

6. かみなりパンチ: 電気をこめた拳で攻撃する技。

7. たきのぼり: 滝を登る勢いで相手にぶつかる技。

8. うちおとす: 石などを投げて相手を撃ち落とす技。

9. はっぱカッター: 鋭い葉を飛ばして攻撃する技。

10. ねんりき: 不思議な力で攻撃する技。

11. こおりのいぶき: 冷たい息を吹きかける技。

12. こおりのつぶて: 氷のかけらを飛ばす技。

13. シャドークロー: 影のような鋭い爪で攻撃する技。

14. のしかかり: 体の重さをかけて攻撃する技。

15. アイアンヘッド: 硬い頭で攻撃する技。

16. マジカルシャイン: まぶしい光で攻撃する技。 Additional concrete visual instructions: No creatures or animals or character faces at all in this sheet. Panel1 show a powerful branching electric discharge through air, no numeric symbols. Panel2 long horizontal flame jet from a plain nozzle. Panel3 icy pale-blue beam freezing a plain target block. Panels4,5,6 show a single plain human training glove or fist respectively surrounded by frost, fire, yellow electric arcs, no whole character. Panel7 upward whitewater surge climbing a waterfall. Panel8 thrown rock striking a plain airborne disc, not a bird. Panel9 razor-sharp whirling green leaves. Panel10 stones floating by a translucent blue force ripple. Panel11 a pale gust forming frost on a block, no character. Panel12 three flying sharp ice shards. Panel13 three dark spectral claw slash arcs, no creature. Panel14 ordinary plain gray sandbag dropping onto a cushion, weight emphasized. Panel15 an unbranded steel head-shaped training dummy in side profile impacting a plain padded target, no eyes, no creature. Panel16 brilliant white-gold radiant starburst with glints, no official game icons. Original natural-effect imagery only; no franchise style. CRITICAL GRID REQUIREMENTS: retain exact original template lines. All four rows exactly equal height, all four columns exactly equal width. The third horizontal divider is at 75% of canvas height, NOT 72% or 73%. All four rows must have identical square interior cell sizes. Uniform continuous straight pure magenta grid. Do not use any pink, purple or magenta artwork close to the magenta lines; shadow effects must be BLUE-GRAY, no purple. All five horizontal lines and all five vertical lines must be solid pure magenta, no fuzzy colored line fringe. In panel8 of the move sheet, the flying wooden disc is being knocked down, tilted in midair with downward motion marks and no supporting pole. Use the exact 4x4 template geometry.

items.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Edit the attached 2048x2048 equal 4 by 4 template. Paint EXACTLY sixteen independent vocabulary illustrations in row-major order. Preserve ALL FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical continuous straight pure MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines INCLUDING OUTER FRAME, exact positions, thickness, equal cell sizes and canvas dimensions. Magenta ONLY in grid lines. Paint only white cell interiors. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with crisp recognizable structure. Use cells generously; no large blank margins required. Every complete subject, background and shadow stays inside its own cell. No text, letters, numerals, labels, logos or watermarks. No copyrighted characters, franchise creatures, recognizable silhouettes, signature character color schemes, game interfaces, official icons or imitation of franchise artwork. Generic original ordinary people only. For a fictional move, show only an original abstract natural effect, ordinary non-character object or generic unbranded training dummy, never any Pokemon or other franchise character. For sports moves show accurately differentiated adult athletes in plain sportswear in a sports setting, anatomically correct arms, hands and legs. For proverbs show an understandable scene expressing the meaning, not merely random objects from the title. Sixteen scenes in exact order:

1. 背負投: 柔道で、相手を背中に乗せるようにして投げる技。

2. 一本背負投: 柔道で、相手の片腕を抱えて背負うように投げる技。

3. 体落: 柔道で、体を回して相手の前方に脚を出し、前へ崩して投げる技。

4. 肩車: 柔道で、相手を両肩に担ぐようにして投げる技。

5. 浮腰: 柔道で、相手を浅く腰に乗せ、体をひねって投げる技。

6. 大腰: 柔道で、相手を腰に深く乗せて投げる技。

7. 払腰: 柔道で、腰に乗せた相手の脚を払い上げて投げる技。

8. 釣込腰: 柔道で、相手を引き上げて腰に乗せ、投げる技。

9. 大外刈: 柔道で、相手の脚を外側から大きく刈って投げる技。

10. 大内刈: 柔道で、相手の脚を内側から大きく刈って投げる技。

11. 小外刈: 柔道で、相手の足を外側から小さく刈って投げる技。

12. 小内刈: 柔道で、相手の足を内側から小さく刈って投げる技。

13. 出足払: 柔道で、相手が足を動かすところを払って投げる技。

14. 送足払: 柔道で、横へ動く相手の両足をそろえるように払って投げる技。

15. 膝車: 柔道で、相手の膝に足を当て、回すように投げる技。

16. 支釣込足: 柔道で、相手の足首付近を足で支え、引き上げながら投げる技。 Judo sport accuracy: TWO original adult athletes in plain judogi on tatami, the acting athlete in blue gi and receiver in white gi. No famous people, mascots or copyrighted characters. Capture the decisive identifiable phase of each named technique. Show exact grip and foot/hip relationship distinctly, no generic repeated throws. All bodies anatomically coherent with exactly two arms and two legs each. Differentiate sleeve-and-lapel shoulder throw from single-arm shoulder throw; hip throws vs foot sweeps; inner vs outer leg reap; groundwork positions vs standing. No blood, no dramatic injury. Arms/legs remain visually traceable. Use simple clear side or three-quarter views, only brief motion strokes to clarify direction, no text or labels. Preserve exact equal-cell grid geometry, all four rows same height and all four columns same width. No magenta or purple in clothes, artwork or tatami; pure magenta reserved for straight divider lines. IMPORTANT: Preserve EXACTLY the template grid. All FOUR rows have precisely equal height: horizontal dividers at25%,50%,75%, not at72% or73%. All16 cells must be same-size SQUARES. In panel3 tai-otoshi, blue actor's leg extends straight across in FRONT OF white receiver's lower leg to block, with sleeve/lapel pull, not a hip lift. In panel15 hiza-guruma, the SOLE OF BLUE FOOT contacts WHITE KNEE from the front/side, blue leg nearly straight; not blue knee-to-white-knee. In panel16 sasae-tsurikomi-ashi the blue FOOT sole blocks WHITE ANKLE, visibly lower than knee, and hands pull upward/forward.

items.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Edit the attached 2048x2048 equal 4 by 4 template. Paint EXACTLY sixteen independent vocabulary illustrations in row-major order. Preserve ALL FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical continuous straight pure MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines INCLUDING OUTER FRAME, exact positions, thickness, equal cell sizes and canvas dimensions. Magenta ONLY in grid lines. Paint only white cell interiors. Clear warm children's picture-book watercolor with crisp recognizable structure. Use cells generously; no large blank margins required. Every complete subject, background and shadow stays inside its own cell. No text, letters, numerals, labels, logos or watermarks. No copyrighted characters, franchise creatures, recognizable silhouettes, signature character color schemes, game interfaces, official icons or imitation of franchise artwork. Generic original ordinary people only. For a fictional move, show only an original abstract natural effect, ordinary non-character object or generic unbranded training dummy, never any Pokemon or other franchise character. For sports moves show accurately differentiated adult athletes in plain sportswear in a sports setting, anatomically correct arms, hands and legs. For proverbs show an understandable scene expressing the meaning, not merely random objects from the title. Sixteen scenes in exact order:

1. 背負投: 柔道で、相手を背中に乗せるようにして投げる技。

2. 一本背負投: 柔道で、相手の片腕を抱えて背負うように投げる技。

3. 体落: 柔道で、体を回して相手の前方に脚を出し、前へ崩して投げる技。

4. 肩車: 柔道で、相手を両肩に担ぐようにして投げる技。

5. 浮腰: 柔道で、相手を浅く腰に乗せ、体をひねって投げる技。

6. 大腰: 柔道で、相手を腰に深く乗せて投げる技。

7. 払腰: 柔道で、腰に乗せた相手の脚を払い上げて投げる技。

8. 釣込腰: 柔道で、相手を引き上げて腰に乗せ、投げる技。

9. 大外刈: 柔道で、相手の脚を外側から大きく刈って投げる技。

10. 大内刈: 柔道で、相手の脚を内側から大きく刈って投げる技。

11. 小外刈: 柔道で、相手の足を外側から小さく刈って投げる技。

12. 小内刈: 柔道で、相手の足を内側から小さく刈って投げる技。

13. 出足払: 柔道で、相手が足を動かすところを払って投げる技。

14. 送足払: 柔道で、横へ動く相手の両足をそろえるように払って投げる技。

15. 膝車: 柔道で、相手の膝に足を当て、回すように投げる技。

16. 支釣込足: 柔道で、相手の足首付近を足で支え、引き上げながら投げる技。 Judo sport accuracy: TWO original adult athletes in plain judogi on tatami, the acting athlete in blue gi and receiver in white gi. No famous people, mascots or copyrighted characters. Capture the decisive identifiable phase of each named technique. Show exact grip and foot/hip relationship distinctly, no generic repeated throws. All bodies anatomically coherent with exactly two arms and two legs each. Differentiate sleeve-and-lapel shoulder throw from single-arm shoulder throw; hip throws vs foot sweeps; inner vs outer leg reap; groundwork positions vs standing. No blood, no dramatic injury. Arms/legs remain visually traceable. Use simple clear side or three-quarter views, only brief motion strokes to clarify direction, no text or labels. Preserve exact equal-cell grid geometry, all four rows same height and all four columns same width. No magenta or purple in clothes, artwork or tatami; pure magenta reserved for straight divider lines. IMPORTANT: Preserve EXACTLY the template grid. All FOUR rows have precisely equal height: horizontal dividers at25%,50%,75%, not at72% or73%. All16 cells must be same-size SQUARES. In panel3 tai-otoshi, blue actor's leg extends straight across in FRONT OF white receiver's lower leg to block, with sleeve/lapel pull, not a hip lift. In panel15 hiza-guruma, the SOLE OF BLUE FOOT contacts WHITE KNEE from the front/side, blue leg nearly straight; not blue knee-to-white-knee. In panel16 sasae-tsurikomi-ashi the blue FOOT sole blocks WHITE ANKLE, visibly lower than knee, and hands pull upward/forward.

Preserve ALL FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical continuous straight pure MAGENTA #ff00ff grid lines INCLUDING OUTER FRAME, exact positions, thickness, equal cell sizes and canvas dimensions. Generic original ordinary people only. For a fictional move, show only an original abstract natural effect, ordinary non-character object or generic unbranded training dummy, never any Pokemon or other franchise character. For sports moves show accurately differentiated adult athletes in plain sportswear in a sports setting, anatomically correct arms, hands and legs. For proverbs show an understandable scene expressing the meaning, not merely random objects from the title. Sixteen scenes in exact order:

1. 硯箱: すずりや筆、墨などを入れておく箱。

2. 文鎮: 紙が動いたりめくれたりしないように載せる重し。

4. 習字セット: 習字に使う筆やすずりなどをまとめた物。

5. 裁縫箱: 針や糸など、縫い物に使う道具をしまう箱。

6. 裁縫セット: 針や糸、はさみなど、縫い物に使う道具をまとめた物。

7. 針山: 針を刺して、安全に置いておくための柔らかい台。

8. 糸切りばさみ: 縫い物の糸を切るための小さなはさみ。

9. 防災頭巾: 災害のとき、落下物などから頭を守るためにかぶる物。

10. 防災袋: 災害のときに必要な物をまとめて入れておく袋。

11. 非常袋: 急いで避難するときに持ち出す物を入れた袋。

12. 気温計: 空気の温度をはかる道具。

13. 水温計: 水の温度をはかる道具。

14. 雨量計: 降った雨の量をはかる道具。

15. 風速計: 風が吹く速さをはかる道具。

Use case: illustration-story. Edit the attached 2048x2048 equal 4 by 4 template. Paint EXACTLY sixteen independent vocabulary illustrations in row-major order. 1. 九死に一生: 助かる見込みがとても小さい危険から、かろうじて助かること。

2. 驚天動地: 世の中を大きく驚かせること。天を驚かせ地を動かすほど、という表現。

3. 虚心坦懐: 思い込みやわだかまりを持たず、素直な心で物事に向き合うこと。

4. 鶏口牛後: 大きな集団の末席にいるより、小さな集団の中心になるほうがよいというたとえ。

5. 蛍雪の功: 苦労して勉強した成果。蛍や雪明かりで学んだ人の話に由来する。

6. 鶏鳴狗盗: 小さな特技でも役立つことがあるというたとえ。鶏の声まねと犬のような盗みの故事に由来する。

7. 呉越同舟: 仲の悪い者同士が、同じ目的のため協力したり同じ場所にいたりすること。

8. 光陰矢の如し: 月日が過ぎる速さを、飛ぶ矢にたとえた言葉。

9. 巧遅拙速: 仕上がりがよくても遅い方法と、多少つたなくても速い方法。仕事の進め方を比べる言葉。

10. 五里霧中: 手がかりがなく、どう進めばよいか分からないこと。深い霧に包まれた様子にたとえた言葉。

11. 虎視眈々: 機会を逃さないよう、じっと様子をうかがうこと。虎が獲物を見つめる姿にたとえた言葉。

12. 胡蝶の夢: 現実と夢の区別がつかないことのたとえ。蝶になった夢を見た荘子の話に由来する。

13. 孤立無援: 仲間や助けがなく、一人きりになっていること。

14. 三顧の礼: 力のある人を迎えるため、心を尽くして何度も頼むこと。劉備が諸葛亮を訪ねた話に由来する。

15. 獅子奮迅: 獅子が勢いよく動くように、力強く活躍すること。

16. 疾風迅雷: 強い風と激しい雷のように、動きがとても素早いこと。 Additional requirements: depict the concise MEANING or the traditional ORIGINAL source episode of each idiom, with original ordinary people and ordinary animals where needed; no franchise interpretations. Chinese historical scenes use simple ancient Chinese robes where relevant. NO modern copyrighted cartoon characters. Never use pink, violet, purple or magenta in artwork, clothes or shadows; magenta reserved only for uniform grid lines. Use blue, green, cream, orange, brown and gold instead. Keep all four rows exactly the same height and all four columns exactly same width. Preserve template divider positions at 0,25,50,75,100 percent. Simple recognizable watercolor illustrations without text, labels or numerals.
